# Selected KayKit transition sources

Kay Lousberg, KayKit Dungeon Remastered 1.0, CC0 1.0 Universal.
Official repository https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Dungeon-Remastered-1.0
Pinned commit b0ca9bd96a8072ab36a3a5464f00ed1e06a16d07.

Only stairs.gltf.glb, stairs_wood.gltf.glb and the included licence were fetched.
Original bytes are retained as stairs-stone.glb / stairs-wood.glb / LICENSE.txt.
intake.json records official paths, byte lengths and Git blob hashes;
provenance.json adds SHA256 after verifying the official blobs.
Repeat with tools/mine_props/intake.py --source <this folder>.

Derivatives rotate each flight to the -Z feature direction, fit to a single
cell, bake neutral palette UVs, gently warp timber/stone edges and add authored
rails, jambs, floor aprons and recessed wells. No original bytes or Actions
were edited. No scripts or plug-ins from the pack are executed.
